games.title: Ember Den
games.description: Explore a firelit cave and use an axe to defeat three approaching eight-legged spiders.
games.prompt: First-person axe combat in a basalt cavern with faceted rock walls, stalactites, glowing teal crystals and amber braziers. Exactly three large brown eight-legged spiders crawl toward the camera. A steel axe on a long wooden handle stays in the lower right foreground without hands or arms. Axe swings leave a pale slash trail, strike sparks and green ichor; spiders rear up before biting; defeated spiders curl up on the ground. Keep the cave layout and spider identities. No extra creatures, text or HUD.

One worker in an orange vest and yellow hard hat moves tile by tile inside gray stone perimeter walls with a few inner wall blocks. Exactly two wooden crates and exactly two brass destination pads.
